scope: Compare baseline and SQLite synonym graph-guided passage discovery on the frozen original historical 22 and the 40 historical follow-up questions.
Add attributed starter history records and twelve questions on USS America CV-66, Mount Airy in North Carolina, and Corona in California.
validation: On the original 22 the graph suggested eligible records for 18/22 and raised complete reference-anchor visibility from 4/21 to 5/21. H09 and H13 gained anchors and no case lost any.

On the 40 follow-ups the graph suggested all reference records for 27/40. One direct or paraphrased question gained an anchor, and fully surfaced cases stayed 14/20. All 12 new starter cases found the intended record.
All 13 scope controls across the follow-ups and new topics withheld full support. Ten focused graph and historical tests passed.
limitations: The graph-guided comparison is a passage inspection probe. Strict proof uses its existing unmodified source path. Curated aliases and prepared source summaries do not establish blind transfer or historical answer accuracy.
Corona was interpreted as the California city. The new corpora use attributed short factual summaries rather than complete copied originals.
next_steps: Measure source-bound proof rules for documentary date roles and attribution separately from graph-guided discovery.
